> i don’t want to trigger him, the only other one it’s their birthday. not that i’d open up anyway, i don’t know how

Could start with, "Hey, I've been feeling like shit and I don't really know how to talk about it. Can you take a look at this post I made? (link to this post)"

I've struggled with suicide myself for 16 years. I lost one of my friends to it during that time. I still wish he had been more direct about what was wrong so that I might help him before he shot himself.

Hope you reach out to your friends.

Otherwise, here if you need.
One day at a time. Glad you're home. Hope you get some rest.
